claim.value: An individual inquiry should also stop when identified sources are exhausted and the remaining uncertainty is documented.
claim.scope: An alternative stopping condition requiring both exhaustion of identified sources and documentation of residual uncertainty; not exhaustion of every conceivable source.

provenance.rationale: P029 explicitly supplies this alternative stopping condition and both required conditions.

signal_basis.value: Record searches report their scope and access limitations; identified sources have been exhausted and the remaining uncertainty has been documented.
signal_basis.scope: The individual inquiry and its identified sources, without asserting complete coverage of all possible evidence or resolution of the approval question.

provenance.rationale: P019 supplies scoped reporting of unsuccessful searches; P029 supplies exhaustion of identified sources and documented uncertainty as the stopping basis.
This bounded procedural stopping condition requires no additional unresolved empirical relation.

rationale: With both conditions satisfied, stopping the scoped individual inquiry is warranted as a procedural endpoint. The claim preserves unresolved uncertainty and does not infer that approval occurred, never occurred, or that no further evidence could exist.
uncertainty: The underlying approval history may remain unresolved; this does not defeat the explicitly uncertainty-preserving stopping condition.
